subject: How to implement search history? (hyperlinks providing past input parameters)

messages.subject: How to implement search history? (hyperlinks providing past input parameters)
parts:
I am intermediate R and Shiny user. I created a Shiny app for browsing medical terms.
It is available here: https://omega.shinyapps.io/dante
 
The app basicaly displays all about medical concept with some id (e.g., 125450)
I would like to find a way, how within UI program an actionButton (or other element) that could
populate the input code that drives the whole application.
For example, I would like to have a tab "recent searches" with 10 last searches that would be "hyperlink" and would repeat the search (display) for term searched 5 searches back.
the functionality would basically override input$numericA parameter in the leftpane.
